input.source:
; The checked runtime program doubles as the macrotime evaluator. Claims name
; the macro even when expansion has zero output rows.
;
; TypeScript-shaped reading aid. These comments describe row signatures only;
; the executable definitions below remain DL7 relations and rules.
;
; type Int = number
; type Text = string
; type NodeId = unknown
; type Value = unknown
; type Relation<Row extends readonly unknown[]> = ReadonlySet<Row>
; type Ref<T> = { readonly ref: T }
;
; Every (: Name (* ...fields)) form declares the tuple accepted by one
; relation. A fact (Name a b) inserts or matches the tuple [a, b], depending
; on whether the call occurs in a rule head or body.
;
; type SyntaxFrontier = Relation<readonly [ordinal: Int, node: NodeId]>
; Top-level syntax nodes are ordered by ordinal.
(: syntax_frontier
   (* (: ordinal int)
      (: node type)))

; type SyntaxForm = Relation<readonly [node: NodeId]>
; Membership means that node carries a parenthesized form payload.
(: syntax_form
   (* (: node type)))

; type SyntaxAtom = Relation<readonly [node: NodeId, name: Text]>
(: syntax_atom
   (* (: node type)
      (: name str)))

; type SyntaxLiteral = Relation<readonly [node: NodeId, value: Value]>
(: syntax_literal
   (* (: node type)
      (: value any)))

; type SyntaxVariable = Relation<readonly [
;   occurrence: NodeId,
;   variable: NodeId,
;   authoredName: Text,
; ]>
; Separate occurrences can share one logical variable identity.
(: syntax_variable
   (* (: node type)
      (: variable type)
      (: name str)))

; type SyntaxSource = Relation<readonly [
;   node: NodeId, path: Value,
;   startOffset: Int, endOffset: Int,
;   startLine: Int, startColumn: Int,
;   endLine: Int, endColumn: Int,
; ]>
(: syntax_source
   (* (: node type)
      (: path any)
      (: start_offset int)
      (: end_offset int)
      (: start_line int)
      (: start_column int)
      (: end_line int)
      (: end_column int)))

; type SyntaxClaim = Relation<readonly [
;   invocation: NodeId,
;   macroName: Text,
; ]>
; A claim says that the rewriter owns this invocation. Zero expansion edges
; means deletion, one means replacement, and several mean an ordered splice.
(: syntax_claim
   (* (: invocation type)
      (: macro str)))

; type GeneratedSyntax = (
;   invocation: NodeId,
;   outputOrdinal: Int,
;   templatePath: Int,
; ) => NodeId
; `intern GeneratedSyntax Args Output` applies this identity constructor.
; Equal arguments yield the same Output identity. Invocation is part of Args,
; so separate source occurrences remain separate.
(: GeneratedSyntax
   (* (: invocation type)
      (: output_ordinal int)
      (: template_path int)))

; Internal helper relation used while constructing emit_atom output.
; type GeneratedAtom = Relation<readonly [invocation: NodeId, output: NodeId]>
(: generated_atom
   (* (: invocation type)
      (: output type)))

; Internal helper relations used while constructing <+ output.
; type PlusForm = Relation<readonly [invocation: NodeId, output: NodeId]>
(: plus_form
   (* (: invocation type)
      (: output type)))

; type PlusOperator = Relation<readonly [invocation: NodeId, output: NodeId]>
(: plus_operator
   (* (: invocation type)
      (: output type)))

; Rule reading aid:
;
;   (<- Head Body0 Body1 ...)
;
; corresponds approximately to:
;
;   for (const binding of join(Body0, Body1, ...)) {
;     Head.add(project(binding))
;   }
;
; A colon call has the common graph-edge signature:
;
; type Edge = Relation<readonly [
;   owner: NodeId,
;   label: Text,
;   target: NodeId | Ref<NodeId> | Value,
;   ordinal: Int,
; ]>
;
; In a body it reads an edge. In a head it derives an edge.
;
; function drop(invocation: FormNode): readonly []
; Claiming the form without deriving expansion edges deletes it.
(<- (syntax_claim ?Form "drop")
    (syntax_form ?Form)
    (: ?Form item ?Head 0)
    (syntax_atom ?Head "drop"))

; function splice2(invocation: FormNode): readonly [
;   invocation.items[1],
;   invocation.items[2],
; ]
(<- (syntax_claim ?Form "splice2")
    (syntax_form ?Form)
    (: ?Form item ?Head 0)
    (syntax_atom ?Head "splice2"))

(<- (: ?Form expansion ?First 0)
    (syntax_claim ?Form "splice2")
    (: ?Form item ?First 1))

(<- (: ?Form expansion ?Second 1)
    (syntax_claim ?Form "splice2")
    (: ?Form item ?Second 2))

; function emitAtom(invocation: FormNode): readonly [AtomNode<"generated">]
(<- (syntax_claim ?Form "emit_atom")
    (syntax_form ?Form)
    (: ?Form item ?Head 0)
    (syntax_atom ?Head "emit_atom"))

; The tuple row builds this constructor argument list without a special
; list value in the macro protocol:
;
; const args = [invocation, 0, 0]
; const output = intern(GeneratedSyntax, args)
(<- (generated_atom ?Form ?Output)
    (syntax_claim ?Form "emit_atom")
    (tuple ?Form 0 0 ?Arguments)
    (intern GeneratedSyntax ?Arguments ?Output))

(<- (node ?Output)
    (generated_atom ?Form ?Output))

(<- (syntax_atom ?Output "generated")
    (generated_atom ?Form ?Output))

(<- (syntax_source ?Output ?Path ?StartOffset ?EndOffset
                   ?StartLine ?StartColumn ?EndLine ?EndColumn)
    (generated_atom ?Form ?Output)
    (syntax_source ?Form ?Path ?StartOffset ?EndOffset
                   ?StartLine ?StartColumn ?EndLine ?EndColumn))

(<- (: ?Form expansion ?Output 0)
    (generated_atom ?Form ?Output))

; function plus(invocation: FormNode): readonly [
;   FormNode<[AtomNode<"<-">, ...Tail<typeof invocation.items>]>,
; ]
;
; The original item 0 is <+. The generated item 0 is <-. Original items 1..
; are copied with their existing identities and ordinals.
(<- (syntax_claim ?Form "<+")
    (syntax_form ?Form)
    (: ?Form item ?Head 0)
    (syntax_atom ?Head "<+"))

(<- (plus_form ?Form ?Output)
    (syntax_claim ?Form "<+")
    (tuple ?Form 0 0 ?Arguments)
    (intern GeneratedSyntax ?Arguments ?Output))

(<- (plus_operator ?Form ?Output)
    (syntax_claim ?Form "<+")
    (tuple ?Form 0 1 ?Arguments)
    (intern GeneratedSyntax ?Arguments ?Output))

(<- (node ?Output)
    (plus_form ?Form ?Output))

(<- (node ?Output)
    (plus_operator ?Form ?Output))

(<- (syntax_form ?Output)
    (plus_form ?Form ?Output))

(<- (syntax_atom ?Output "<-")
    (plus_operator ?Form ?Output))

(<- (syntax_source ?Output ?Path ?StartOffset ?EndOffset
                   ?StartLine ?StartColumn ?EndLine ?EndColumn)
    (plus_form ?Form ?Output)
    (syntax_source ?Form ?Path ?StartOffset ?EndOffset
                   ?StartLine ?StartColumn ?EndLine ?EndColumn))

(<- (syntax_source ?Output ?Path ?StartOffset ?EndOffset
                   ?StartLine ?StartColumn ?EndLine ?EndColumn)
    (plus_operator ?Form ?Output)
    (syntax_source ?Form ?Path ?StartOffset ?EndOffset
                   ?StartLine ?StartColumn ?EndLine ?EndColumn))

(<- (: ?Output item ?Operator 0)
    (plus_form ?Form ?Output)
    (plus_operator ?Form ?Operator))

(<- (: ?Output item ?Child ?Index)
    (plus_form ?Form ?Output)
    (: ?Form item ?Child ?Index)
    (before ?Form 0 ?Index))

(<- (: ?Form expansion ?Output 0)
    (plus_form ?Form ?Output))
